title: Waste connection.
officialText:
Garbage can washers shall be trapped separately. The receptacle receiving the waste from the washer shall
have a removable basket or strainer to prevent the discharge of large particles into the drainage system.
SECTION PC 415
LAUNDRY TRAYS
